Subject: Evidence request: onboarding/offboarding training + bg-checks for SOC 2 sampling

Hi Nikhil (and Kimberly),

We're kicking off the SOC 2 sampling for Lumeno's vendor review and need a narrow set of artifacts related to employee onboarding and offboarding for a subset of roles (engineering, product, and CS). Can you provide the following by EOD 8/17?

- A training completion roster (role, hire date, training modules completed, completion dates) for hires from 01-2027 -> 07-2028. CSV preferred.
- Redacted background-check summaries for the same cohort (names redacted, unique IDs retained so we can match to the roster).
- A short note on your deprovisioning timeline (how quickly do you revoke access after termination / role change) and logs or snapshots if available.

Please indicate if any of this requires an NDA or secure transfer. We're able to accept a temporary SFTP drop or a secured Drive share.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Cassandra Bryant
Senior InfoSec Manager
Lumeno

Hi all — looping in HR ops details. We can produce the roster and the redacted background summaries. A couple of items to confirm before we share:

- Scope: you asked for engineering, product, and CS hires. Do you want contractor/contingent workers included? If so, we will need to pull additional vendor screening artifacts.
- Redaction standard: we intend to redact PII (full name, SSN, DOB) and replace with an internal employee ID (e.g., EID-####). Is that acceptable? For the auditor, we typically keep the ID mapping internally; if Lumeno needs mapping, we will need a signed NDA.

Deliverables we'll attach to the share:
- training_roster_aug2028.csv (CSV) — columns: EID, role, hire_date, module_list, completion_dates, manager
- redacted-bg-summaries.pdf (PDF) — one page per person, sensitive fields redacted, includes verification outcome (Cleared/Conditional) and check date
- deprovisioning_summary.txt (TXT) — timeline and system names for access revocation (IAM, single sign-on, VPN, GCP project roles)

We will mark any contractor entries and can exclude them if you prefer. Priyom — please prepare an SFTP drop and send the credentials in a secure message or share a Drive link with restricted access.

Kimberly Park
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_bg_summary_redacted_example.pdf (PDF)]
